baseline.name: continuous
baseline.share_basis: request sampling probabilities, not completion quotas

current.name: continuous
current.share_basis: request sampling probabilities, not completion quotas

provenance.access_mode_mapping: convert every SES sequential/random channel to random reads or writes; merge identical group/operation/transfer-size channels while preserving their summed probability
provenance.adaptation: SES1.2.0-derived logical inventory and read/write/transfer-size shares; all source access modes converted to pure random; added conditional object Zipf0.99 with IID per-I/O object and legal-offset selection; not SES certification

idfs_expansion.method: increase logical file counts, retain size classes and SES read/write/size shares; use pure random offsets in aligned independent object slots
idfs_expansion.runtime: unmodified Vdbench5.04.06 plus separate User extension; no SES installation

provenance.limitation: pure random adaptation does not retain the SES sequential/random mix; container changes inode/directory/open metadata; conditional class mixture is not one global Zipf; finite sampling and coverage still depend on I/O count; no native AI event replay
provenance.object_mapping: 4MiB-aligned exclusive original-file/fragment slots; reversible mapping; runtime excludes padding
provenance.object_selection: Zipf0.99 over all4MiB objects within each original size class; baseline uniform objects; fixed Fisher-Yates ranks seeded by1048596 XOR logical_size_bytes
provenance.operation_mapping: preserve source reads and writes; overwrite prepared synthetic payload
provenance.preparation: full-container formatting allocates padding too; partial original-file objects become full-sized slots
provenance.random_rule: uniform legal4KiB-aligned offsets inside the selected object; no object or logical-file boundary crossing
provenance.sampling: per-channel IID pseudorandom uniforms through the object CDF; with replacement, repeated objects allowed; domain-separated run-seed streams distinct from request/offset RNG; no request or time quota
provenance.timing: one600sRD;1s internal time slices with stationary SES-derived probabilities; no reseeding at slice boundaries; no per-second quota
